title: Perfect objects on an affine scheme are finite projective complexes
statement: Let $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be a perfect object of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there is a bounded complex $P^\bullet$ of finite projective $A$-modules and an isomorphism $E\cong\widetilde{P^\bullet}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$, where $\widetilde{P^\bullet}$ is the termwise associated quasi-coherent complex.
